clauses.mechanism: termination of the War Production Board by EO 9638 sec. 1, effective under sec. 8 as of the close of business on November 3, 1945 (parent body ended)
clauses.reason: whole: Paragraph 1 of Executive Order 9024 is amended to include three more officers as members of the War Production Board. The clause continues, amended, as long as the Board exists (owner ruling 2026-10-21, strike-and-insert). EO 9638 sec. 1 says the Civilian Production Administration is established and "is hereby terminated" applies to the War Production Board (the sentence 'The War Production Board is hereby terminated.' is printed across two lines), and sec. 8 makes the order effective as of "the close of business on the third day of" November, 1945. The Board, and with it the clause enlarging its membership, therefore ended on 1945-11-03 (inclusive; the exclusive reading is that it ended as that day closed, the same instant). The amendment recorded before and after: before, the Board's membership under paragraph 1 of EO 9024 did not name these three officers; after, it did, until the Board ended.

research_rationale:
EO 9335 (signed April 19, 1943) was read in full in the registered held text, the pdfplumber recheck of the Federal Register page (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_9335.recheck.txt, 8 FR 5425, grade original_representation_unverified; reading-order text rebuilt from the scan's OCR word positions; page images were not compared). It amends paragraph 1 of EO 9024 of January 16, 1942, as amended, to add the Chairman of the War Manpower Commission, the Director of the Office of Defense Transportation and the Petroleum Administrator for War as members of the War Production Board. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments the clause continues, amended, until its parent ends. The parent body ended when EO 9638 (signed October 4, 1945; 10 FR 12591) terminated the War Production Board effective as of the close of business on November 3, 1945, so the membership clause ended with the Board on 1945-11-03. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.

savings.reason: EO 9638 transfers the functions and powers of the Chairman of the War Production Board to the Civilian Production Administrator and creates the Civilian Production Administration to carry the Board's functions; the Board membership that EO 9335 enlarged is not carried over, so nothing of the clause continues under EO 9638 as a membership command.
